correctness.rationale: Full eight-state Markov generator reconstructed, normalized stationary solution solved symbolically, all three current equalities verified; derivative exact quartic with signs +++-- on the admissible domain, so a unique strict global optimum follows from Descartes and endpoint signs. All rational expressions have positive denominators. Exact homogeneous, fast-centre and large-dwell limits, strict benchmark comparison and special radical value are checked. A self-contained SymPy verifier and 45 exact rational state-space checks are provided; the latter do not substitute for the universal proof.

originality.rationale: The primary 2026 paper covers the same class of open site-disordered SEP but approximates general nonlinear response and proves only reflection-oddness exactly. The present contribution is an all-contrast exact current rational function together with a parameter-uniform unique rate optimum, not its known current-reversal symmetry. Related indexed notes concern four-site rectification; older homogeneous and periodic works do not dominate the claimed optimum. Genuine full-text and indexed searches leave an unindexed finite-state-priority risk.

value.rationale: A naturally motivated, complete and sharp parameter-uniform transport-design classification for the smallest boundary-driven exclusion chain with a real interior site: infinitely fast interior hopping is not optimal, a unique finite speed improves flow, and exact all-contrast formulas quantify a substantial 11.17% example. The result goes beyond a generic monotonicity or fitted finite-size observation and distinguishes true rate optimization from symmetry/rectification.
